lanes.title: Terminology normalization
lanes.focus: Normalize Estonian technical vocabulary, model/version names, acronyms. Preserve meaning.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify at most one term whose usage is inconsistent or non-idiomatic in Estonian technical writing within the target file.
lanes.writer_extra: Apply a surgical rename or rewording in the target file only. If no clear win, push back and commit nothing.

lanes.title: Chapter readiness polish
lanes.focus: Flow, signposting, paragraph coherence inside one chapter.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the single weakest transition or paragraph in the target chapter.
lanes.writer_extra: Rewrite at most that paragraph or transition. No new claims. No new references.

lanes.title: Committee-facing explanation
lanes.focus: Anticipate a likely defense committee question and tighten the passage that already tries to answer it.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Pose one committee-style question and point to the passage meant to pre-empt it.
lanes.writer_extra: Tighten that passage so a skeptical committee member cannot easily push on it. Do not introduce new claims.

lanes.title: Claim–evidence alignment
lanes.focus: Each claim must be backed by a concrete number, table, figure, or cited source.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find one claim whose evidence is vague or missing in the target file.
lanes.writer_extra: Either attach the existing evidence in-text, or soften the claim to what is defensible. No fabricated numbers.

lanes.title: Literature gap framing
lanes.focus: How the Kratt work positions against existing Estonian NLP / wake-word literature.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one place where the literature gap or positioning is weak or missing.
lanes.writer_extra: Strengthen that positioning using sources already in references.bib. Do not invent citations.

lanes.title: Formal LaTeX compliance
lanes.focus: TalTech/Estonian thesis formal style: quotes, dashes, units, cross-references, figure/table captions.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one concrete formal-style issue in the target file (e.g., straight quotes, missing non-breaking space, broken \ref).
lanes.writer_extra: Fix only that one issue. No stylistic rewriting.

lanes.title: Summary tightening
lanes.focus: Keep summary crisp, self-contained, aligned with actual contributions.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find the single sentence in the summary that overclaims, underclaims, or drifts from the thesis contributions.

lanes.title: Methodology tightening
lanes.focus: Reproducibility of wake-word methodology: data, augmentation, training, evaluation.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one methodology detail that a reader could not reproduce from the current text.
lanes.writer_extra: Add the missing detail concisely in-place. Do not expand scope.
